content.title: ‘Euphoria’ Season 3: Rosalía, Marshawn Lynch and More Join Cast as Nika King and Others Exit - IMDb
content.text: ‘Euphoria’ Season 3: Rosalía, Marshawn Lynch and More Join Cast as Nika King and Others Exit“Euphoria” officially started production on Season 3 this week, with a few new fresh faces.Grammy winning artist Rosalía, Super Bowl champ Marshawn Lynch and “A Different World” star Kadeem Hardison have joined the cast of the hit high school drama, HBO announced on X. Other new cast members include Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Toby Wallace, Darrell Britt-Gibson, Priscilla Delgado, James Landry Hébert and Anna Van Patten.Most of the main cast is returning, including Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, Hunter Schafer, Jacob Elordi, Eric Dane, Alexa Demie and Maude Apatow. Martha Kelly and Chloe Cherry have both been upped to series regulars.
